name: report_scrapper
description:
i want to create an agent that helps me search the internet for the latest news on politics, technology, medicine, education, and other major aspect.

This agent must always make a deep and detailed search from genuine source to make sure to have accurate information on the report to be created

it must always fact check every details and know which one is more important to have and which is false

every morning by 9am it must always create a [report_name].md file containing the report based on the research it has made.
